description: Retells the release of the 108 spirits, Gao Qiu’s ascent through court patronage, Shi Jin’s loss of his household, and Lu Da’s transformation into the Flower Monk Lu Zhishen. Introduces Lin Chong’s vulnerability to official abuse and examines righteousness, friendship, sanctuary, and the tension between compassionate action and private violence in the novel’s linked outlaw biographies.
